long/en.title: Can 0 and 1 Talk?
long/en.description:
Mia's paper note will not fit through the pipe. She and Leo try a shared code: gold for one, blue for zero.

Send PLAY, follow yes-or-no clues to a hidden gift, and find the watermelon snack. Then try a message of your own with the browser lab or a printed code table.

A story for families about binary messages, bits, bytes and asking useful questions.

Try the browser lab and printable worksheets: https://ai.lucasacademy.org/courses/zero-and-one/

Chapters
00:00 A note that will not fit
00:24 Two tiny signals
00:49 A shared code
01:24 PLAY arrives
01:52 Find the hidden gift
02:38 Why four questions?
03:02 The watermelon clue
03:37 Your turn

ASCII reference: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc20

By Lucas Academy Team

long/zh.title: 0和1，能聊天吗？
long/zh.description:
米娅的纸条塞不进管子。她和里奥先约好：金色表示一，蓝色表示零。

把 PLAY 传过去，再用是否问题找出藏礼物的箱子，看看里面是什么点心。看完也能和孩子试试：打开网页实验室，或者打印编码表，互相出一道消息题。

跟着两个朋友的小冒险，认识比特、字节、编码和提问的方法。

网页实验室和可打印学习单：https://ai.lucasacademy.org/courses/zero-and-one/

short/en.title: Can 0 and 1 Talk?
short/en.description:
The note gets stuck. Tiny signals get the invitation through!

Join Mia and Leo for an adventure in space: send a message, find a hidden gift and send a reply. Their tiny pipe leads us to the internet, where videos, messages and even chats with AI use zeros and ones.

A funny story? A new game? What will you share today?

Try the browser lab and printable worksheets: https://ai.lucasacademy.org/courses/zero-and-one/

By Lucas Academy Team
Narration: Louise, synthetic voice in English and Chinese.
Fictional space scenes: Muse. Environment artwork: ImageGen. Teaching graphics, original music and sound effects: Lucas Academy.

short/zh.title: 0和1，能聊天吗？
short/zh.description:
纸条卡住了，邀请却送到了！

跟着米娅和里奥，传消息、找礼物，再回一声「收到啦」。从两个朋友的小管子，看到连起全世界的互联网：视频、消息，连和 AI 聊天，都用零和一。

一个好玩的故事？一个新游戏？今天你想分享什么？
